location: Sharma Estate (urban setting — a large family mansion within the city, not an isolated rural property)
lighting_notes: Harsh, unyielding overhead sun — high Directional Light intensity, small Source Angle for hard-edged shadows (opposite of the soft dusk look used elsewhere). Matches the script's 'sun beats down with heavy, unyielding light.'
action: Establishing shot. An imposing mansion surrounded by high stone walls, set within an urban skyline/cityscape — production decision: the whole episode is set in an urban environment rather than a traditional rural estate, so the mansion should read as an old-money house standing out within the city, not a standalone countryside property.
continuity_notes: Pure establishing shot, no characters or dialogue. Sets the Sharma Estate location used again in sc02 and sc08. See ASSET_SOURCING.md for the urban-asset plan (City Sample as the backdrop city, the mansion itself built/dressed separately within it).
